title: Criteria/matrix mismatch
text: Criteria/matrix mismatch: the counting rule requires a clean result from “both Ronda configurations,” which implies a sweep-off control is needed before a pull request can count, but lines 461–464 and 496–503 say the sweep-off control is required only for comparative claims and that the ten-item count defines no sweep-off baseline. Specify whether descriptive-tier counting requires sweep-off evidence and make UC6, AC15(b), and the decision matrix agree.
rationale: Real defect: the flagged lines changed in c1df9fe, the next commit. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head. Spec PR counted in scope: Ronda reviews spec PRs and reports no findings. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
